commits.headline: fix(keyboard-mouse): the mouse focuses only what the arrows can reach, version 1.2.1
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Hovering or clicking on the pause menu's Quick Select page crashed the
game (SIGBUS in select_world_object_resource_tables, from
update_item_preview_binding). The mouse asked the game to focus any page
widget under the cursor, labels and the item preview included. The game
itself only moves the focus along an item grid's up/down/left/right
links or a text list's up/down (update_menu_grid_selection and
update_menu_entry_actions), and the Quick Select's preview reads the
focused widget as an item…

commits.headline: test(keyboard-mouse): keep the fake widget updates distinct, which MSVC folded into one
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The load test told an item grid from a text list by its fake update's
address. The three fakes had the same body and MSVC's identical-code
folding gave them one address on Windows, so the list was taken for a
grid. Each now returns its own value.

commits.headline: fix(keyboard-mouse): find the map by its handler's function in every level, version 1.2.2
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The map's Enter and click (Circle) checked the focused widget's handler
against DrawMapScreen's executable address (0x0021CE60 on PAL). In a
level the menus run from that level's copy of it (level 11's at
0x0029FD10), so the check never matched in the pause menu's map. The
disc now names the function, and the widget's handler is compared
through function_at, as the focus links are.

Tests: the load test's map is found at the executable's place and at a
level copy's.

commits.headline: fix(keyboard-mouse): the mouse selects the grid cell under it, version 1.2.3
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Over a focused item grid (Weapons, Gadgets, the Quick Select editor) the
mouse's motion stepped the d-pad, so the selection moved by how far the
mouse went rather than to what was under it, and drifted away from the
cursor. The mod now lays the grid out as draw_menu_item_grid does (the
widget's rectangle, its menu moby's frame, the icon size at D_00160390,
the margins, rows and columns) and queues the d-pad presses to the cell
under the cursor, a row at a time and then a column. A click on…
